title: Frostline: Last Train to Haven
tagline: One shovel, two fires, eight named passengers, 100 km of snow and one very big war-wagon.
pitch: You're the only crew left on the last train out. The engine wants coal so it can outrun the raiders, and the passengers want coal so they don't freeze. Meanwhile: raiders on snowmobiles, wolf packs, car fires, avalanches, a cat called Mr. Whiskers, and at the very end, the Iron Jaw.
bad_idea_note: we added a boss fight. To a train game. In two days.
controls: Unzip and run Frostline.exe. Keyboard or gamepad. Move with A/D, ladders W/S, jump Space, E does everything else, J swings the wrench, S on a roof ducks. Duck. Seriously.
